question: To locate the center of gravity of a triangular thin plate using the suspension method, draw a line on the plate along the suspension string each time the suspended plate comes to rest. The center of gravity lies on these lines. What is the minimum number of times the plate must be suspended to determine the position of its center of gravity?
solution: Two nonparallel lines intersect at one point. Suspending the plate 2 times produces two lines, and their intersection is the center of gravity.
